Latin word

adeō

adeō, adīre, adiī, aditum

verb, irregular (ad + eō), conjugation

go to, approach (a person); indeed, for that matter; moreover, besides, too; for that matter; so much, to such a degree (with a verb)

In this lexicon

  • approach

    also used · classical · Plaut. Rud. 242: accēde ad mē atque adī contrā

  • for that matter

    the recommended word · classical · Enn. ap. Prob.: Juppiter, tūque adeō summe Sōl (Lewis & Short: joined with a pronoun to turn attention to it); Traupman 317

  • further

    also used · classical · Plaut. (Lewis & Short s.v. adeō: ibi tibi adeō lectus dabitur, a bed, too, shall be given you there); Traupman 344: for that matter, adeō

  • so

    also used · classical · Traupman 382

  • adeō … ut: extent

    classical
